name: Mortal Resolve
description:
While Incapacitated, press your Secondary Ability key to rise for one final stand. §oTrust in yourself right now. Let your heart burn it up. You can change the world.§r
 
You revive and gain Resistance IV and Strength IV for 1 minute. When that minute ends, you die outright. While Mortal Resolve is active, death is final and cannot Incapacitate you again.
